entries.title: Choose where your first character is created, and Outfits for new characters
files: shared/config/config.lua (Locations.Creator is now a Creators list, Sections.Outfits added)

changes.text: After the intro, new players choose where their character is created: a black studio or a daylight place. The character is moved there behind a short fade so they see themselves in it, and the same choice is in Settings

The Outfits page is now in the first character creator too: ready outfits, import by code and saved outfits, free like the rest of character creation. Config.NewCharacter.Sections.Outfits = false hides it again
Config.NewCharacter.Locations.Creators is a list of places (id, label, coordinates); add your own, or keep one place to skip the choice. A config with the old single Creator spot keeps working
The character no longer drops in when moved to a creator place; it is put on the floor while the screen is still black
The hair colour panel no longer slides under the total cost card: the Fade row is visible again
The Settings panel is about 17 % shorter and scrolls when it has more rows than fit
The Head category has a clearer cap icon

entries.title: Share outfits with a nearby player or with a code

changes.text: Share an outfit with a player standing next to you: choose it, pick the player and the name they will see; they get an Accept / Decline prompt and it lands in their saved outfits
One Share popup for everything: send to a nearby player or copy a code, for the outfit you are wearing or any saved outfit; open it with X or the new card at the top of Outfits
Share codes now start with CYLEX- (older CYX- codes still work), and the same outfit always gives the same code
New Settings option to stop receiving outfit offers
Config.ClothingShare: turn sharing on or off, set the distance, the time to answer and the cooldown, and choose whether the receiver pays for the pieces (off by default)
The icon buttons in Saved outfits now explain themselves when you hover them
The Export button is now called Share
The Pose / Light menus no longer jump to the left right after opening
Config.Branding was removed; the confirm button stripes and the etched X are always shown

entries.title: Favorites, and a clear answer when the skin tone does not change

changes.text: Favorites: press the star on clothes, accessories, hairstyles, brows, beards, chest hair, makeup and tattoos to keep them, then find them all in the new Favorites tab
New /pedmenu command: players pick a ped from the server's ped list, seeing only the peds their job, gang or permission allows; switching to an allowed ped is free
When the third parent's Strength is covering your skin tone, the Strength row now says so, and changing the skin tone tells you where to turn it off
Heritage > Variation is now called Third Parent and shows Shape, Skin and Strength on separate rows, like the old Race section
The Favorites tab has filters with counts and a search box, and puts an item on with one click; it can also be reached with Q / E
Favorites are saved per character and stay correct when new clothing packs are added to the server
Favorites only show what the current shop sells and what the current body type can wear; job-locked and blacklisted items stay hidden
A short opening intro plays before the first character creator; Enter or Esc skips it
Longer notifications now stay on screen longer so they can be read
shared/peds.lua now explains how to add peds and limit them to jobs, gangs, permissions or single characters, with examples
The Intro on/off setting was removed; the intro now always plays when a new character is created
Character creation now survives a crash: if the game crashes, times out or your PC shuts down before you save, you continue editing from where you left off the next time you join
Eye colors are now shown as images instead of a plain list
Skin tone now has a Second Color and a Blend option
Body blemishes have been added to the Skin tab as their own category
The fade no longer disappears when you change your hairstyle
The fade can now be removed again
A problem with hairstyles has been fixed
Several problems with CTRL+Z have been fixed
Saved outfits can now be deleted
Server-side performance has been improved
